repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个Claude Code插件，AI智能体技能，自动抓取过去30天内Reddit、X、YouTube等8大社交平台及网页内容，通过多信号质量排名算法和跨源收敛检测，生成基于真实引用的趋势摘要。支持对比模式分析技术选型，自动保存研究简报，帮助开发者快速掌握AI领域最新动态。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code plugin that automatically researches topics across 8 social platforms including Reddit, X, YouTube, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, and Polymarket from the last 30 days. It employs multi-signal quality-ranked relevance scoring, cross-platform convergence detection, and composite ranking algorithms to synthesize grounded narratives with real citations. Features include comparative mode for side-by-side analysis, automatic saving of research briefings, smart subreddit discovery, and per-project configuration. Helps developers stay current with AI trends and community discussions.

repos.description: 100+ open-source clones of popular sites like Airbnb, Amazon, Instagram, Netflix, Tiktok, Spotify, Whatsapp, Youtube etc. See source code, demo links, tech stack, github stars.
repos.summary_zh: Clone Wars是一个GitHub开源仓库，收录100多个流行网站和应用的开源克隆与替代项目，包括Airbnb、Instagram、Netflix、Spotify等。提供源码、演示链接、技术栈及星标数据，专为学习设计。分带教程的克隆表和普通克隆/替代表，展示React、Next.js、Firebase、Django等多种技术栈。核心价值是curated学习资源，帮助开发者通过实际项目掌握全栈开发、构建作品集并探索开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Clone Wars is a curated GitHub repository featuring 100+ open-source clones and alternatives to popular sites like Airbnb, Instagram, Netflix, and Spotify. It includes source code links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts for learning web development. Divided into a tutorials table for guided full-stack projects and a clones/alternatives table distinguishing UI clones from functional alternatives. Showcasing technologies such as React, Next.js, Firebase, and more, it enables developers to explore implementations of popular features, enhance skills through practical examples, and find open-source substitutes. Perfect for self-learners and portfolio building.

repos.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI Agent提供高质量HTML PPT生成能力，内置电子杂志与瑞士国际主义双视觉系统，支持单文件横向翻页演示、多平台封面生成及Codex配图流程。解决AI生成PPT的视觉质量控制难题，适用于个人风格演讲、产品发布及方法论展示，输出无需构建、可直接打开的HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: An AI Agent skill for generating polished HTML slide decks with dual visual systems: editorial magazine and Swiss internationalist styles. Enables single-file horizontal presentations, multi-platform social covers, and Codex-integrated image generation. Solves visual quality control for AI-generated slides, ideal for personal talks, product launches, and methodology showcases with zero-build delivery.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
repos.summary_zh: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
repos.summary_en: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

repos.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
repos.summary_zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
repos.summary_en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

repos.description: Transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts using AI. Open-source, multi-platform, and supports multiple languages.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI视频转写工具，支持YouTube、TikTok、Bilibili等30+平台及本地音视频文件。采用字幕优先架构，无字幕时调用Faster-Whisper实现高精度语音识别，经AI优化后生成多语言摘要。支持任意OpenAI兼容API，Docker部署，适合内容创作者与研究者快速提取视频核心内容。
repos.summary_en: An open-source AI-powered video and podcast transcription tool supporting 30+ platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Bilibili, plus local audio/video file uploads. Its subtitle-first architecture extracts native subtitles instantly when available, using Faster-Whisper as fallback for high-accuracy speech recognition. The tool leverages any OpenAI-compatible API for intelligent text optimization, typo correction, and multi-language summarization. Built with FFmpeg for media processing and Docker support, it's ideal for content creators, researchers, and educators to efficiently convert multimedia content into structured, searchable text with AI-enhanced summaries.

repos.description: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
repos.summary_zh: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
repos.summary_en: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

repos.description: Free open-source Multilogin/Incogniton/Kameleo alternative for fingerprint spoofing (Canvas/WebGL/User-Agent). Perfect for Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer automation, web scraping, social media bots, ads verification, and multi-accounting based on chromium. Avoid bans, bypass anti-bot systems, and prevent tracking with customizable stealth browsing
repos.summary_zh: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser 是一款基于 Chromium 的开源反检测浏览器，提供全面的指纹欺骗能力，覆盖 Canvas、WebGL、字体等关键维度。其独家一致性分析引擎确保所有欺骗字段逻辑自洽，有效绕过反机器人系统。内置自动化模块完美兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer，适用于网络爬虫、社交媒体多账号运营及广告验证等场景，是 Multilogin 等商业方案的开源替代。
repos.summary_en: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser is an open-source anti-detection browser built on Chromium that delivers comprehensive fingerprint spoofing for Canvas, WebGL, fonts, and more. Its exclusive consistency analysis engine ensures logical alignment across all spoofed fields to effectively bypass anti-bot systems. With built-in automation modules fully compatible with Playwright/Puppeteer, it's ideal for web scraping, social media multi-account management, and ad verification, offering a powerful free alternative to commercial solutions like Multilogin.

repos.description: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
repos.summary_zh: 开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill，将文章或视频一键转化为小红书图文、公众号排版、杂志长图及 AI 配音口播短视频。10 个独立能力自由组合，21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖，仅需 Node.js 22 与 Chrome。
repos.summary_en: Open-source Claude Code / Codex Skill that transforms articles or videos into Xiaohongshu cards, WeChat layouts, magazine long images, and AI-narrated short videos. 10 independent capabilities, 21 themes, automated validation, zero npm dependencies, requiring only Node.js 22 and Chrome.

repos.description: ⚡ StreamGet -  A Multi-Platform Live Stream Parser Library for Python
repos.summary_zh: StreamGet 是一个轻量级 Python 直播流解析库，支持 40+ 主流平台（抖音、TikTok、B站、小红书等）的 HLS/FLV 协议。采用异步架构提供统一 API，无需为各平台单独开发解析逻辑，可快速构建直播监控、数据采集、内容分析与自动录播应用，显著降低开发门槛。
repos.summary_en: StreamGet is a lightweight Python library for real-time live stream acquisition, supporting HLS/FLV protocols across 40+ platforms including Douyin, TikTok, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu. It provides a unified async API that eliminates platform-specific parsing logic, enabling rapid development of live stream monitoring, data collection, content analysis, and automated recording applications while significantly reducing development complexity.
